body.name: \(\mathfrak C\)
body.construction: Record the rational output \(q^+\), the six rational ledger bounds, finite rational partitions \(\mathcal P_t,\mathcal P_h,\mathcal P_V,\mathcal P_z\), outward intervals \(\mathcal I_G\) for every evaluation of \(G\), outward intervals \(\mathcal I_\phi\) with rational range-reduction and Taylor-remainder witnesses for every Gaussian density or elementary-function bound, and the rational lower bound \(L_{\mathrm{CDF}}\) for \(\inf_{h\in\mathcal H,V\in\mathcal K_V}P\{S(h,Z_V)\le q^++\omega_t+\omega_h+\omega_V\}\) after subtraction of all probability-ledger upper bounds. Also record the rational upper radius \(B_\gamma^+\) and a branch bit. A verifier using exact rational arithmetic checks partition coverage, every directed-rounding inclusion, \(\omega_t+\omega_h+\omega_V\le\zeta\), \(\omega_{\mathrm{tail}}+\omega_{\mathrm{int}}+\omega_{\mathrm{fp}}\le\gamma\), and either \(L_{\mathrm{CDF}}\ge1-\alpha+\sqrt{\overline\varepsilon_n}\) on the refined branch or \(q^+\ge2B_\gamma^++(B_\gamma^+)^2/2\) together with the outward-certified inequality \(2d\exp\{-(B_\gamma^+)^2/(2v_{\max})\}\le\alpha-\sqrt{\overline\varepsilon_n}-\gamma\) on the fallback branch.
